verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no budgets, spend caps, warehouse-style resource monitors, or auto-suspend of idle compute that would stop a runaway query or idle cluster automatically. The only related features are SQL-based monitored alert rules with thresholds and Slack/webhook destinations, plus manual pause/cancel controls on batch jobs. These are adjacent controls that notify or require human action rather than enforcing a cost stop, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, budgets, resource monitors, or auto-suspend stop a runaway query or idle compute from burning money overnight

citations.quote: Turn any SQL query against your cluster into a monitored rule: set an operator, threshold, interval, and severity, start from a template
